attributeName.description: Name of the view-model attribute the scan result is written to. The barcode preprocessor generates the scanned request from it when none is authored; set this instead of wiring the request by hand.

lookupFilterColumn.description: Column used to filter the lookup a scan resolves against, when the scan feeds a lookup selection.

isFloat.description: True, if button should be float (FAB).

timeScale.description: Attribute holding the time grid step in minutes (15, 30 or 60), like [viewMode].

focusDate.description: Attribute name that determines which days are currently visible and focused.

useDateRangeMode.description: True, if needed to select the date range.

value.description: Attribute name that determines selected date range.

searchValue.description: Drill-down search text attribute. The preprocessor emits it as a binding (`$DYN_..._SearchValue`), so the prefix is stripped to get the attribute name.

searchFilterChange.description: Handled by the generic `SearchFilterRequestHandler`, which stores the value into [searchValue].

labelPosition.description: Where each option's label sits relative to its value. Consumed by the communication-options preprocessor before deserialisation; defaults to auto.

cellContentAlignment.description: Alignment of cell content. Defaults to [Alignment.topLeft].

expanded.description: If true, the component transitions to expanded mode.

showHeaderColumnDividers.description: Whether to draw vertical dividers between columns.

showLockIcon.description: Whether to show the lock icon on non-editable columns in the grid caption/header. Null preserves the previous automatic per-column behavior.

verticalScroll.description: Whether component should have vertical scrolling.

displayType.description: Visual representation of the boolean cell. Defaults to [BooleanCellDisplayType.toggle] when `null`.

createdOnAttributeName.description: Attribute that holds the created on date of the record.

entityName.description: Entity name to fetch DCM stage data for.

filteringColumn.description: State attribute bound to the column used for DCM filtering.

recordId.description: Record ID to fetch DCM runtime information for.

stageConnections.description: State attribute that stores DCM stage connections.

stages.description: State attribute that stores loaded DCM stages.

value.description: Binding to the current stage attribute.

expanded.description: Whether component should be expanded by default.

tools.description: List of tools widgets, placed in header panel.

tag.description: Free-form tag copied onto files uploaded through this list, for grouping. Consumed by the upload-file request preprocessor; defaults to an empty string.

viewType.description: View type for the file list.

safeArea.description: If SafeArea true, the container will be wrapped bottom padding (or add scrollPadding) to avoid app BottomBar overlay.

menuItems.description: Configuration of menu items that are displayed when the button is pressed.

folderTreeVisibleChanged.description: Config of request (look at crt.OpenModalFolderTreeRequest), that opens picker with list of folders.

maxWidth.description: Maximum width to constrain the folder button.

rootSchemaName.description: Root schema name for folder tree.

sourceSchemaName.description: Source schema name for folder tree.

components.description: Configuration for Gallery component that displays items in a grid layout.

items.description: Data source for gallery items (attribute name).

specificPage.description: Specific page name to open when item is clicked.

useSpecificPage.description: Whether to use a specific page when item is clicked.

adaptive.description: Adaptive configuration describing per-breakpoint overrides for this component.

columns.description: List of column definitions. Each string represents a column (e.g., ["1fr", "1fr"]). For now, only the count is used (ignore "fr" values).

searchValue.description: Drill-down search text attribute. The preprocessor emits it as a binding (`$DYN_..._SearchValue`), so the prefix is stripped to get the attribute name.

searchFilterChange.description: Handled by the generic `SearchFilterRequestHandler`, which stores the value into [searchValue].

blankSlateText.description: Custom text shown when the list has no data.

itemLayout.description: Row the list renders per record - a crt.ListItem carrying the title and the body fields. One element, not a collection.

body.description: Elements rendered under the row title. An array whose entries are each a body field (value/label/showEmptyValues) or any component config such as {"type": "crt.Button"}; the list-item preprocessor wraps it into the body element before deserialisation. A single component config is also accepted in place of the array.

subtitles.description: Secondary lines under the title. Each entry is either a binding string, or `{ "value": "$Column", "label": { "value": ..., "position": ..., "visible": ... } }` when the line needs a label of its own — see the class example above.

items.description: Collection binding used by map data loading. Contract: this binding must stay stable during component lifecycle. Runtime datasource rebinding via `items` is not supported.

clicked.description: Config of click event on menu item.

valueChange.description: Configuration for request on change event.

color.description: Color schema for the Slider component.

items.description: Attribute name of the collection to be sorted.

components.description: One tab inside a `crt.TabPanel`. Declaration-only: the type has no widget and is NOT registered in [ComponentConfigDeserializer]. `tab_panel_preprocessor.dart` rewrites a `crt.TabPanel` holding `crt.TabContainer` items into a `TabPanelHeader` + `ToggleContainer` structure before deserialisation, so the type is legal in a page schema yet never reaches the deserializer as a standalone element. This stub exists only to keep the type's authoring contract and its doc in the runtime, where the contract belongs — the registry generator discovers it by the tag below, not through the widget scan or the deserializer map.

caption.description: Tab title shown in the tab header; read by `tab_panel_preprocessor.dart`.

readonly.description: Is the cell in readonly mode.
Is the cell in readonly mode.
Is the cell in readonly mode.

components.description: A single tile inside a `crt.Timeline`. Declaration-only: the type has no widget and is NOT registered in [ComponentConfigDeserializer]. The timeline renders its tiles itself from its own `items` configuration (see `TimelineTileType`), so a page schema never writes a `crt.TimelineTile` element or any property on it — it carries no authorable input of its own beyond the shared base. This stub keeps the type's name and its doc in the runtime; the registry generator discovers it by the tag below, not through the widget scan or the deserializer map.

nameTemplate.description: Display name template. Use `{0}` as placeholder for the user's first name (e.g. `'Hello, {0}!'`).

_filterOptions.description: Declarative filter wiring, consumed by the filter-options preprocessor before deserialisation and turned into calculated attributes. Set it instead of binding a filter by hand; it is honoured on any element, and in practice belongs on the quick-filter and folder-tree components.

adaptive.description: Adaptive configuration describing per-breakpoint overrides for this component.

bindTo.description: The name of a view model attribute to which the component's state is bound. This property links the component to a specific piece of data in the page's view model. For example, the visibility of the component can be controlled by the `visible` property of the bound attribute. If this property is null, the component's [name] is used as the binding key instead.

flexConfig.description: Written on the element itself, beside `type`, never on a wrapper object. IGNORED unless the parent puts this element in a slot typed FlexItemConfig, so it is not a property every component takes.

layoutConfig.description: Written on the element itself, beside `type`, never on a wrapper object. IGNORED unless the parent puts this element in a slot typed GridLayoutItemConfig, so it is not a property every component takes.

name.description: Name of the axis, which is displayed in the chart.

formatting.description: Format configuration for the axis values. Determines how the values are displayed in the chart.

decimalSeparator.description: Decimal separator character for number formatting.

decimalPrecision.description: Number of decimal places for number formatting.

thousandSeparator.description: Thousand separator character for number formatting.

dateTimeFormat.description: Date/time format pattern for datetime formatting.

flashToggle.description: Whether to enable the flash feature.

beepOnScan.description: Whether to play a sound when a barcode is successfully scanned.

filterAttributeName.description: The name of the attribute to set the filter on.

viewAttributeName.description: The name of the view model attribute bound to the filter target.

BooleanCellDisplayType.description: Display variants for the boolean cell of the DataGrid edit component.

overdueColumn.description: Column whose value decides whether a record may be shown as overdue.

notCompletedValues.description: Values of [overdueColumn] for which a record is *not* completed yet, and so may be shown as overdue once its end time has passed.

DataGridColumnDefinition.description: Column definition for data grid component.

cellView.description: Config of component that should be used for preview\"read only" column.

editingCellView.description: Config of component that should be used for editing.

DataTableSortingConfig.description: Sorting config for data grid component.

GalleryItemConfig.description: Configuration for gallery item appearance and data mapping.

templateValuesMapping.description: Mapping of template values to data source attributes.

specificPageRecordId.description: Record ID property for opening specific page.

GalleryTemplateValuesMapping.description: Template values mapping for gallery items.

GridContainerBreakpointConfig.description: Configuration for a specific screen size breakpoint.

LabeledStateProperty.description: Represents metadata of value with label. Keys are not described by the generated contract.

LayoutAdaptiveConfig.description: Adaptive configuration for layout based on screen size.

LayoutBreakpointConfig.description: Configuration for a specific screen size breakpoint.

ListItemBodyField.description: One field inside a crt.ListItem body, as a page schema writes it.

value.description: Binding to the column rendered, e.g. $PDS_Stage.

label.description: Label options for the field, e.g. {"isVisible": true}.

showEmptyValues.description: Render the field even when the bound value is empty. Inherited from the row when the row declares it.

isVisible.description: If true then column data will be present in the result set.

QueryFilter.description: Query filter interface. Keys are not described by the generated contract.

params.description: Parameters merged into the request. Bindings are resolved against the page context before it is dispatched.

RequestBindingConfig.description: Wiring for one output. An array of these dispatches each in turn.

stacked.description: Determines if the scale is stacked. When true, data series will be stacked on top of each other.

xAxis.description: Configuration for the X axis. Defines how the X axis will be rendered and its properties.

yAxis.description: Configuration for the Y axis. Defines how the Y axis will be rendered and its properties.

color.description: The color of the scale in the chart.

style.description: Visual style of the line for line/spline/area chart types. Supported values: 'solid' (default), 'dashed', 'dotted'.

indexNumberCaption.description: Custom caption shown in the center of a doughnut chart. Overrides the auto-computed dominant-segment caption when set.

SliderColor.description: Color variants for the Slider component.
